Rock Boulder Dry
https://polyhaven.com/a/rock_boulder_dry
Photography: Dimitrios Savva. Processing: Rico Cilliers.

Bark Willow
https://polyhaven.com/a/bark_willow
Photography: Dimitrios Savva. Processing: Dario Barresi.

Bundled files are downloaded originals, with source URLs and checksums in pbr-materials-sources.json.
Color maps are sRGB; normal and roughness maps are linear/non-color. Normals use OpenGL (+Y).
No live asset API is used by the game.
